scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:runtime && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run check:api && npm run check:app && npm run test:runtime && npm run check:go && npm run test:auth && npm run check:stories
scripts.check:scripts: npm --prefix web exec -- biome check --config-path=web --error-on-warnings scripts package.json
scripts.check:app: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run test && npm run build
scripts.check:go: env -u DATABASE_PATH -u FEEDLR_INTEGRATION_TESTS go vet . ./internal/... && env -u DATABASE_PATH -u FEEDLR_INTEGRATION_TESTS go test -race . ./internal/... && env -u DATABASE_PATH -u FEEDLR_INTEGRATION_TESTS go build -trimpath -o tmp/feedlr-check . && env -u DATABASE_PATH -u FEEDLR_INTEGRATION_TESTS go build -tags dev -trimpath -o tmp/feedlr-dev-check .
scripts.check:stories: npm --prefix web run build-storybook && npm --prefix web run test:stories && npm --prefix web run test:visual
scripts.test:auth: env -u DATABASE_PATH -u FEEDLR_INTEGRATION_TESTS go test -tags browser_e2e ./internal/server/webapi -run TestBrowserPasskey -count=1 -timeout=120s
